name: HP printers (all models)
summary: HP's own open-source driver suite, HPLIP, supports most HP printers on Linux.

linux.notes: After installing HPLIP, press "Check again": the model-specific driver will show up as an installed driver.

darwin.notes: Apple distributes an "HP Printer Drivers" package through Apple Support and Software Update. Many models also work driverless via AirPrint.
